order.quote: our series of Preferred Stock rank, from highest to lowest, as follows: STRF Stock, STRC Stock, STRE Stock, STRK Stock, and STRD Stock,

STRF_top.value: STRF senior to STRC, STRE, STRK, STRD
STRF_top.quote: Our Class A Stock, Class B Stock, STRC Stock, STRE Stock, STRK Stock and STRD Stock constitute dividend junior stock and liquidation junior stock.

STRC_second.value: STRC junior to STRF; senior to STRE/STRK/STRD
STRC_second.quote: Dividend Junior Stock includes the Class A Common Stock, the Class B Common Stock, the Perpetual Stream Preferred Stock, the Perpetual Strike Preferred Stock and the Perpetual Stride Preferred Stock.

STRE_third.value: STRE junior to STRF/STRC; senior to STRK/STRD
STRE_third.quote: Liquidation Senior Stock includes the Perpetual Strife Preferred Stock and the Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock.

STRK_fourth.value: STRK junior to STRF/STRC/STRE; senior to STRD
STRK_fourth.quote: Dividend senior stock includes the STRF Stock, STRC Stock and STRE Stock. For the avoidance of doubt, dividend senior stock will not include any securities of the Company’s subsidiaries.

STRD_last.value: STRD junior to all other preferreds
STRD_last.quote: Our indebtedness, STRF Stock outstanding, STRC Stock outstanding, STRE Stock outstanding and STRK Stock outstanding rank senior to the STRD Stock outstanding.

debt_above_all.value: $6.75bn indebtedness senior to all preferreds at 2026-06-30
debt_above_all.quote: we had approximately $6.75 billion in aggregate principal amount of outstanding indebtedness, all of which ranks senior to our Preferred Stock and our common stock.
